name: Script FFI C ABI compatibility requires a C wrapper fixture

input.fixture_ref: Call a C-compatible wrapper symbol with C-compatible records, then attempt a Rust-ABI-only symbol through script FFI.

applicability.reason: Requires a library exporting BOTH C-compatible and implementation-language-only symbols. C049 turns on script FFI refusing the latter, and the existing fixtures export C symbols only, so the refusal has nothing to refuse.

expect.status: Script FFI accepts only declared stable C ABI calls and makes no Rust ABI compatibility promise.
